description: Upload a local workbook to the WorkbookAPI hosted API as a new model, or a new version when model_id is given. Sends the whole workbook file and its file name. Returns the API model id, version id and compatibility report. Uses a model slot for a new model and counts against daily uploads; bills no calculation scenarios. Requires an admin key. Files must be at most 10 MiB.

model_id.description: Hosted model id returned by upload_model.

path.description: Local workbook path; at most 10 MiB; .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx or .xltm.

name: upload_model
